input.free_text_description: This system is a content management platform that serves Content Creator, User roles. It exposes interfaces for managing article, html, user. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with article functionality, so that I can accomplish my article-related tasks.
As a Content Creator, I want to interact with html functionality, so that I can accomplish my html-related tasks.
